scope: Service coordinates atomic receipts with owned-task state before signalling.
Replay does not interrupt again, does not restore an old run version after pin publication, and cannot touch a newer queued attempt.
Queued cancellation returns original cancelling acknowledgement plus current cancelled state. Uncertain publication blocks dispatch and replays after store reopen with current interrupted state.
limits: Internal service boundary only. Authenticated HTTP routing, response contracts and browser controls remain open.
Store-reopen replay uses the same supplied actor identity; it does not restore an invalid browser session or grant fresh sessions access to old receipts.
Production adapters remain unregistered; tests use inert owned adapters.
No packaged browser test for this operation; prior idle-expiry evidence is scoped to its earlier archive.
